title: Founding Member, Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Company Description**

**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

 **Job Description**

The Digital Solution Consultant helps transform high-value business opportunities into practical, testable Digital & AI solutions. Working at the intersection of business, technology, and user experience, this role partners with practices and corporate teams to understand how work gets done, identify where technology can create meaningful value, and translate promising ideas into pilots that can be tested and validated with real users.

This is not a traditional business analyst, project manager, or technology support role. The Digital Solution Consultant takes ownership of the business side of individual initiatives, from initial discovery and opportunity definition through pilot validation, adoption, and value realization. Working closely with Innovation Engineers and enterprise technology partners, this individual helps rapidly test concepts, gather user feedback, refine solutions, and determine whether an initiative should scale, remain business-led, undergo further iteration, or stop.

This role also offers the unique opportunity to join as a founding member of J.S. Held’s new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As part of the hub’s initial team, the Digital Solution Consultant will have the opportunity to help shape its culture, ways of working, and approach to identifying and delivering Digital & AI solutions, while building strong partnerships with colleagues and technology teams across the global organization.

As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, this individual will also help establish a repeatable model for identifying, validating, and scaling high-value Digital & AI opportunities across the firm. The role is ideal for someone with a builder mindset, strong business judgment, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and hands-on execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Discovery & Opportunity Shaping**

* Partner with practices and corporate functions to understand workflows, pain points, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve how work gets done.
* Translate loosely defined ideas into clear problem statements, target users, use cases, expected outcomes, and testable hypotheses.
* Conduct workflow discovery through interviews, observation, workshops, document review, and other user-centered research methods.
* Assess current processes, tools, information flows, data needs, user behaviors, and constraints before recommending a solution path.
* Assess opportunities and provide recommendations to support portfolio prioritization based on business value, user demand, feasibility, readiness, risk, and potential for reuse.
* Challenge solution-first thinking and ensure the team is solving a meaningful business problem before committing resources.

**Pilot & Solution Validation**

* Lead the business-side planning and execution of pilots, proofs of concept, and targeted experiments.
* Define pilot scope, target users, user journeys, requirements, acceptance criteria, feedback methods, and success measures.
* Work side by side with Innovation Engineers to translate business needs into practical prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and other digital solutions.
* Coordinate pilot participants and facilitate structured testing with subject-matter experts and end users.
* Gather, synthesize, and prioritize user feedback; distinguish critical workflow needs from preferences and feature requests.
* Iterate rapidly with technical resources to refine the solution, user experience, and delivery approach.
* Determine whether a pilot solves the intended problem and recommend whether to scale, refine, defer, remain business-led, transition to enterprise delivery, or stop.

**Value Realization & Adoption**

* Establish initiative-level value hypotheses, baselines, expected benefits, and practical measures of success.
* Measure adoption, usefulness, workflow impact, cycle-time improvement, quality, capacity, risk reduction, revenue enablement, or other relevant outcomes.
* Develop initiative-level adoption, training, and enablement approaches that help users incorporate successful solutions into their workflows.
* Help users incorporate new capabilities into how work is actually performed, rather than treating technology as an add-on.
* Identify barriers to adoption and work with business sponsors, users, and technical partners to resolve them.
* Communicate pilot results, lessons learned, and recommendations in clear, decision-oriented language for business and executive stakeholders.

**Portfolio Learning & Scale**

* Document decisions, assumptions, outcomes, and lessons across initiatives to improve the Foundry operating model.
* Identify common patterns, reusable requirements, and capabilities that could serve multiple practices or workflows.
* Help prevent fragmented point solutions by evaluating whether existing platforms, tools, or reusable building blocks can meet the need.
* Provide initiative-level progress, outcomes, value measures, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and reporting.
* Build and improve repeatable methods, templates, playbooks, and standards for discovery, pilots, validation, adoption, and value measurement.
* Collaborate with Digital, IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners as required by each initiative.
* Maintain a business-led perspective while ensuring solutions are shaped with appropriate technical, security, data, governance, and support considerations.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Design, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in digital transformation, product management, innovation, consulting, business process improvement, technology-enabled transformation, or a related field, including hands-on experience shaping and delivering digital solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex or ambiguous business problems and workflows into practical technology-enabled solutions, including problem definition, user needs, requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading pilots, proofs of concept, or iterative solution development with real users, including gathering feedback, prioritizing improvements, validating value, and driving adoption.
* Experience shaping AI-enabled solutions using technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform, Azure DevOps, workflow automation, AI agents, or similar platforms, with sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with engineers and architects.
* Strong business judgment and ability to develop value hypotheses, business cases, baselines, success measures, and recommendations on whether solutions should scale, be refined, remain business-led, or stop.
* Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work across senior business leaders, subject-matter experts, engineers, architects, and risk partners.
* Working knowledge of technology architecture, data, security, privacy, integrations, cloud platforms, production support, and governance considerations sufficient to shape solutions effectively with technical teams.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment, with exposure to product management, service design, human-centered design, business architecture, or user research methods.
* Self-directed builder mindset with experience operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, balancing speed and experimentation with enterprise standards, and identifying opportunities for reuse and scale.

  
**Additional Information**

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable adjustment in relation to any of the above, please email jobs@jsheld.com and include “Applicant Adjustment” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**

J.S. Held understands all of our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely when needed
* Generous Annual Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

**EEO and Job Accommodations**

*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*

*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a ServiceNow -Technical Lead to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN-DL), India (IN).
  
  
ServiceNow Technical Consultant
  
  
**Location:**  
Remote / On-site (as required)s
  
  
**Job Type:**  
Full-Time
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking a highly certified and experienced Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant to lead and deliver complex ServiceNow implementations and solutions. This role demands deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a passion for driving digital transformation through the ServiceNow platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, and other modules.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and architect scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior consultants and developers.
* Customize and configure ServiceNow applications using best practices and maintain platform integrity.
* Integrate ServiceNow with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and other integration tools.
* Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and ensure adherence to security and compliance standards.
* Stay current with ServiceNow releases and proactively recommend platform enhancements.
* Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, demos, and proposal development.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform development and administration.
* Proven track record of successful ServiceNow implementations in enterprise environments. - 2+ Years

**Certifications (Required/Preferred):**  

* Required:
* Junior – CSA and at least 1 CIS-(any) and CAD
* Intermediate – CSA and at least 2 CIS-(any) and CAD
* Senior – CAS and at least 3 CIS(Any) and CAD

**Skills Competencies:**  

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture and data model.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, GlideScript, Flow Designer, and ServiceNow Studio.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?
  

* Work with a team of passionate ServiceNow experts.
* Opportunity to lead high-impact digital transformation projects.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Continuous learning and certification support.

We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
